_doc: Kampf plan 1000, areas Traits (241-280) and Keepsakes (281-320). Read by scripts/battle/TraitKit.gd. 'traits' are gifts with the same effect keys as BattleRules.TRAITS plus the keys TraitKit handles (see its header). A Spirling gets one of them only as an extra gift next to its own: a Rift boss through 'boss_traits', a Prism Spirling through 'prism_trait' (every 'share'-th uid), an unfolded Spirling through 'bonus_traits' once its kinship reaches 'min_kinship'. 'keepsakes' lists the ids of the held items of this plan (data/items.json) and 'tourney_bans' the ones a tournament rule may lock.

spare_flame.label: Spare Flame
spare_flame.text: Arts that cost 5 Energy or more cost 1 less.

prism_skin.label: Prism Skin
prism_skin.text: Very effective hits on it lose a quarter of their force.

counter_current.label: Counter Current
counter_current.text: Hits it already shrugs off lose even more force.

quiet_heart.label: Quiet Heart
quiet_heart.text: Shakes off its condition when it steps back to the bench.

glow_hide.label: Glow Hide
glow_hide.text: A physical art that hits it may Scorch the attacker.

pack_sense.label: Pack Sense
pack_sense.text: Hits 15% harder while more than one Spirling stands on each side.

loner.label: Loner
loner.text: Hits 10% harder in a battle of one against one.

sentinel.label: Sentinel
sentinel.text: On its first turn in front it acts before any other art.

field_runner.label: Field Runner
field_runner.text: A Rift field gives it twice the boost, and twice the drawback.

echo_soul.label: Echo Soul
echo_soul.text: A Resonance field it lays holds 2 turns longer.

hush_core.label: Hush Core
hush_core.text: Every condition on it lasts only half as long.

lantern_light.label: Lantern Light
lantern_light.text: When it steps in, it and every ally in front gain Focus.

cold_sleep.label: Cold Sleep
cold_sleep.text: While Drowsed it mends an eighth of its Vigor each turn.

shock_pad.label: Shock Pad
shock_pad.text: Takes no recoil from its own arts.

lucky_cap.label: Lucky Cap
lucky_cap.text: Lands critical hits a little more often.

nimble.label: Nimble
nimble.text: Steps back for free: no Energy cost, and nothing roots it in place.
